memory_update.text: LOPE is the reference public asset for online/hybrid university-services infrastructure because its revenue model is tied directly to university partner enrollments and service delivery.

COUR should be tracked as an underfollowed university-services platform candidate rather than only a consumer edtech company; key survival test is growth and monetization of institutional, degree, and enterprise channels.

STRA is an adjacent workforce-education infrastructure candidate; the key evidence gap is whether ETS, Sophia Learning, Workforce Edge, and employer-affiliated enrollment become material enough to dominate the investment narrative.
BNED is a speculative-shadow second-order supplier for higher-ed course-material access infrastructure; high relevance must be weighed against accounting, leverage, and legacy retail risks.

The node is broader than classic OPM: credible scaling of online/hybrid programs can involve enrollment services, learning distribution, employer tuition-benefit infrastructure, degree/micro-credential platforms, campus course-material access, and compliance-heavy student-success operations.

Need a later pass on private or non-US-listed tools that may hide the true chokepoints: Ellucian, D2L, Instructure ownership status, state authorization/compliance vendors, CRM/student-retention systems, and nursing simulation providers.

node: Online program management and university-services infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expands the online/hybrid university-services node beyond obvious OPM exposure into adjacent infrastructure: university service providers, online degree/course distribution, employer-linked workforce education platforms, and campus/course-material distribution that supports measurable student access and outcomes. The best-supported reference asset is Grand Canyon Education / LOPE. The underfollowed lane includes Coursera, Strategic Education, and Barnes & Noble Education as less pure but plausible second-order beneficiaries. Claims below are research candidates only, not trading recommendations.
